messages:
sara: FYI: Nimbus Health just pushed back 10am20 — they want tenant-level "routing parity" before signing pilot. They call out exact-match fallbacks, per-tenant token budget, and model allowlist.
vik: ouch. Do they want full policy language or just the controls surfaced?
anya: SE note: they need three controls for compliance: 1) per-tenant model allowlist, 2) deterministic fallback chain (must be auditable), 3) soft token budget that triggers throttles/alerts. Not asking for a policy DSL.
sara: ok. that's narrower than a policy engine but still non-trivial. timeline ask: pilot by end of month.
rafa: engineering POV: we can do a scoped feature (controls shim) that wires into smart-routing for fallbacks and the quota service for budgets. Est: 2 engineers, 3 weeks to ship safely with canary. Full policy engine is 10w.
kevin: sales says competitor X promises parity next week. If Nimbus goes to them they likely won't return. This is a revenue + strategic logo play.
sara: proposal: triage into two tracks: TRACK A (pilot parity shim) -> ship in 3w with feature-flag and audit logs. TRACK B (policy engine) -> Q3 scoped project, 10w. Commit to Nimbus in writing if pilot OK.
anya: minimal shim checklist: - allowlist config (tenant) - fallback list (ordered) with deterministic choice logging - soft budget with alert and optional hard throttle - admin toggle + audit trail.
vik: ops: audit logs need to include: request_id, tenant_id, selected_model, fallback_chain, decision_reason. Storage: append to KV is ok for 30 days, long-term to analytics pipeline.
rafa: small config example for shim:
```json
{"tenant":"nimbus","allowlist":["rw-large","rw-small"],"fallback":["rw-small","rw-mini"],"token_budget":{"soft":500000,"hard":600000}}
```
kevin: commercial: want a calendar milestone and a post-pilot SLA discussion. I'll run contract language by contracts.
contracts-bot: Reminder: any written commitment >30d requires GC review.
sara: noted. We'll avoid multi-month promises. We'll offer a milestone commit: "policy engine scoped for Q3" and pilot parity shim delivery date.
anya: UX: minimal admin page with allowlist checkboxes, fallback ordering drag handle, budget sliders. We can reuse existing quota UI components; mock in 2 days.
vik: infra: recommend per-tenant FF in config service and a canary rollout to Nimbus-only hostpool. Use existing canary flow. deploy-bot: Canary plan queued: "nimbus-parity/shim-rc1" -> nimbus-only pool -> regional -> global.
rafa: risks: coupling shim to routing runtime could increase p95 tail; we must add perf tests. Acceptance criteria: p50 delta <+20ms, p95 <+60ms, audit log lag <5s.
kevin: Nimbus legal will want audit retention details. We should clarify 30-day default retention and add paid options for longer.
sara: decision: APPROVE TRACK A (parity shim) with FF and audit logs; commit to TRACK B scoping in Q3. Action list: @rafa spike perf tests and start implementation, @anya create mockups, @vik provision canary pool, @kevin draft customer milestone language, @sara coordinate contracts.
rafa: starting implementation today. Will post spike numbers by EOD Friday.
anya: mockups posted in Figma by Tue.
vik: canary pool ready in 4 business days.
kevin: initial customer milestone email draft to Nimbus by tomorrow.
sara: thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for Nimbus parity decisions.
